description: Observation vector layout per junction for AEGIS MAPPO inference and training. Per-junction lane counts reflect P2 actual Town10HD_Opt SUMO network geometry (network SHA256: 3ef9501d4bb19f868f49395e39007876f834cbfe713f864a7ea8413f98115004). Model uses slot_count=4 for all junctions with partial masking where actual lanes < 4. Joint P2/P3 review required before actuation.

J1._note: 6 actual lanes aggregated into 3 approach-pair slots. Slot 3 unused/masked.

J2._note: 6 actual lanes aggregated into 3 approach-pair slots. Slot 3 unused/masked.

J3._note: 8 actual lanes aggregated into 4 approach-pair slots. Full slot utilisation.

J4._note: 4 actual lanes in 2 approach pairs. Slots 2 and 3 unused/masked.

lane_queues.description: Normalized queue length per lane slot (0.0=empty, 1.0=at capacity). Slots beyond active_slots are zero-padded.

missing_masks.description: 1.0 if the sensor for that slot is unavailable; agent must impute or act conservatively. Unused slots report 0.0.

observation_ages_s.description: Seconds since last valid observation for each slot. Unused slots report 0.0.

current_phase_onehot.description: One-hot encoding of current policy action index (not raw SUMO phase index). Policy index 0-3; masked positions are always 0.

elapsed_phase_s.description: Seconds elapsed in current green phase, normalised by max_green_s.

neighbor_inflow.description: Estimated inflow from each of the 4 neighbouring junction slots (vehicles per decision interval). Zero if no neighbour.

junction_id_onehot.description: One-hot encoding identifying which junction (J1=slot0, J2=slot1, J3=slot2, J4=slot3).

_metadata.description: Frozen observation vector definition per junction for AEGIS MAPPO. Compatible with obs_dim=25 trained model.
